description: This Java class 'KeywordIndex' handles indexing of product data for keyword search, extracting and weighting various product attributes, related entities, and content resources to build a searchable keyword index.

classes.name: KeywordIndex
classes.description: Provides static methods for indexing product data into a keyword search index, including handling product attributes, features, content, and related entities.

methods.name: forceIndexKeywords
methods.description: Forces reindexing of keywords for a given product.

methods.name: indexKeywords
methods.description: Indexes keywords for a product, with optional full reindexing.

methods.name: indexKeywords
methods.description: Main method that performs the indexing process, extracting and weighting product data and related entities.

methods.name: addWeightedDataResourceString
methods.description: Adds content from a data resource to the index with specified weight.

methods.name: addWeightedKeywordSourceString
methods.description: Adds a product attribute or related entity string to the index with specified weight.
